To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

coronary artery endothelial dysfunction does not contribute to the pathogenesis of hypertension in SHR, but that enhanced alpha-adrenergic contraction of coronary arteries may contribute to the pathophysiology of coronary artery disease in SHR.
coronary arteries of SHR exhibit enhanced endothelium-dependent and endothelium-independent vasodilation and enhanced alpha-adreno-receptor mediated vasoconstriction.
coronary arteries from SHR do not have an impaired endothelium- dependent relaxation but exhibit enhanced alpha-adrenergic-mediated contraction that is unaltered by antihypertension treatment.
